sentences.text:
The present application under Section 439 of the CrPC seeks regular bail in case FIR No.
420/2023 under Section 376 of the IPC and Section 4 of the POCSO Act registered at PS Binda Pur.
2.

The case of the prosecution, as stated in the status report dated 19.09.2023 authored by SHO PS Binda Pur is as under:
"1. That on 15/07/2023 a case FIR No. 420/2023 U/S 376 IPC & 4 POCSO was registered at PS Bindapur on the statement of Child victim wherein she stated that one year earlier, the accused person Sumit Gupta used to come to her house when they were living at A-130 Gulabi Bagh Uttam Nagar, New Delhi.
One day in the morning time when her mother went to the temple and the accused person was at her home.

The child victim got counseled by CIC counselors.

sentences.text: On 16.03.2022, when she went to temple and the accused person and her daughter/child victim age 10 years were at home, when she returned from the temple, she saw that her daughter/child victim was running on the staircase, on this when she asked from her daughter, what happened, the child victim narrated to her that accused Sumit Gupta touched her inappropriately.
After 2-3 days my daughter/ child victim told me that Sumit Gupta put his penis in her anus.
Accordingly, she has given a written complaint of the incident."
2. That on 17.07.23 statement of victim was recorded U/S 164 Cr.PC before Ld. MM, Dwarka Court Delhi in which she stated that the accused Sumit Gupta put his pee part into my Poop part.
3. That on 23.7.2023, the accused was arrested.
He was sent to Judicial custody and he is still in judicial custody.
4. The child victim mother also filed a case bearing FIR No. 17/2023 dated 28.01.2023 against the same accused Sumit Gupta u/s 376 IPC at PS Connaught Place.

Her mother stated that she also did not mention about this fact in the complaint filed by her against the accused as she was told by her previous counsel that two separate complaints will be filed for the offences committed by the accused against her and her daughter.
The case bearing of FIR No. 17/2023 is under trial before Hon'ble Jurisdictional Court.
Further, the child victim mother stated in her statement that she was under threat and fear form the accused owing to which she could not file the complaint immediately after the incident.

It is humbly submitted that during the course of investigation, the mother of child victim stated in her statement that she was receiving the threat from some unknown person on the behalf of the accused person.
Accordingly, after enquiry Section 506 was also added in the FIR."

3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that the mother of the victim had got registered an FIR bearing no. 17/2023, under Sections 376 of the IPC, at P.S. Connaught Place against the present applicant on 28.01.2023.

16.02.2021 and 12.11.2021.
It is submitted that in the aforesaid FIR, there is not a single averment made with respect to the incident dated 16.03.2022 which is subject matter of the present FIR.

It is further submitted that during the hearing of the bail application in FIR no. 17/2023, the applicant herein had demonstrated that he was travelling on 19.02.2021 to show that the allegations in the said FIR are false.

Subsequently, it is submitted, the complainant filed a complaint with the Bar Council of Delhi on 06.03.2023, wherein she blamed the lawyer for wrongly advising her and writing the wrong date with respect to an incident in the FIR no. 17/2023.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that a co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 28.03.2023, in BAIL APPLN. 1012/2023, seeking anticipatory bail granted interim protection to the present applicant in the FIR no. 17/2023.
It is pointed out that immediately thereafter on 29.03.2023, the mother of the victim for the first time made the allegation, which is the subject matter of present FIR.
It is further submitted that the present FIR is malafide, have been registered only to falsely implicate the present applicant.
It is further submitted that the investigation in the present FIR is complete and chargesheet stands filed.

The applicant is in judicial custody since 23.07.2023.
5.

Per contra, learned APP for the State assisted by learned counsel for the complainant submits that the allegations in the present FIR have been corroborated by the victim in her statement under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C.
It is pointed out that the incident was not reported earlier as the mother of the victim was told by previous counsel that two separate complaints shall This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 20/10/2023 at 00:33:15 be filed for the offences committed by the applicant herein.

It is submitted with regard to the same,
a complaint with Bar Council of Delhi has been filed against the said counsel.
6.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
7. FIR bearing no. 17/2023 under Sections 376 of the IPC, P.S. Connaught Place at the instance of mother of the victim, in the present FIR, was registered on 28.01.2023.
Admittedly, no averment has been made with regard to the present allegation in the said FIR, although, the alleged date of incident is 16.03.2022.
It is not the case of the mother of the victim that she was told about this incident subsequently.
In the present FIR itself, it is mentioned that the victim had informed her about the incident at the contemporaneous point of time.

So far as the explanation given by the mother of the victim is concerned, the complaint made by her with the Bar Council of Delhi, does not make any allegation with respect to what has been stated by her to the police.
In the said complaint, there is no mention of her informing the counsel about the alleged incident in the present FIR and the failure of the counsel to file a complaint with regard to the same.
It is further noted that investigation in the present FIR is complete and the chargesheet stands filed.
8. In totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, the present application is allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail, on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 50,000/- with one surety of like amount, to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court/Link Court, further subject to following conditions:
i.
The applicant shall not leave India without prior permission of the learned Trial Court.
This is a digitally signed order.
